points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair keeps every class-matched candidate in a local vector through both publish calls. extract_detection_candidates stores source_index as that detection's slot in the Detection2DArray. select_detection (default highest_confidence) returns one DetectionCandidate by value and leaves the other candidates in that vector. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once, and only the chosen source_index is passed through as instance_id, stored on PoseResult.instance_id or FailureResult.instance_id. publish_pose writes PalletPoseStamped with yaw, face normal, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, chamfer_cost_m, and this pair's input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp (det_msg->header.stamp and depth_msg->header.stamp; ApproximateTime queue 10, slop 0.10 s). That message has no sent or deferred index fields, and neither instance_id nor the leftover source indexes are copied onto it. publish_ok_diagnostics emits chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, and the same two stamps. On estimate failure the only publish is publish_failure_diagnostics, whose KeyValues are failure_reason plus those two stamps. Two early returns publish nothing: select_detection empty, and a depth_image_to_meters exception. The sent index and the other class-matched source indexes (detector postprocess caps max_detections at 10) are already in that on_pair vector. Writing them onto PalletPoseStamped when a pose is published, and onto the failure diagnostic when the estimate fails, is a few integers. Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the chamfer search below.

Measured stage-2 time is that single estimate. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs: free coarse is 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m) and free fine is 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((cost_reliable_hi_m 0.020 - free_cost) / (0.020 - cost_reliable_lo_m 0.006), 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when free_cost is at or below 0.020 - 0.014 * (1 - 0.05/3) = 0.006233... m. The prior search is centered on the PCA init_pose, not on free_pose. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. The four grids are 45692 evaluations. On that path each of the four stage searches also evaluates its seed once before the grid (the zero-offset cell is evaluated again inside the grid), choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds two full costs, the anchor chamfer_cost_v2 adds one and runs before the lambda_eff branch, and the post-prior data-only chamfer_cost_v2 adds one, 45700 chamfer evaluations in total. OpenMP schedule(static) does not reduce that count; the critical section runs once per thread.

Each of those evaluations is O(N log N) with N=182. cached_prototype builds the default contour once and rebuilds it only when shape parameters change: 1.20 x 0.14 m outer face plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m 0.03, using n = max(2, ceil(length/spacing)+1) per edge with the endpoint omitted (94 + 44 + 44). rotate_proto_into writes the N x 2 rotation into thread-local ChamferTls.rotated once per theta (proto * R.transpose() only when theta changes). chamfer_cost_from_rotated still assigns tls.translated = rotated and adds tx, ty on every pose, bilinear-samples all N distances, assign-copies them into tls.sorted, and std::sorts all N even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N) = 164. sample_bilinear_into setConstant-fills the distance buffer before the loop. The bilinear reads are Eigen column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), a stride of N doubles. At 45700 evaluations the translation copy is 133078400 bytes and the sort copy is 66539200 bytes, before the sort itself.

Before the grid, once per posed detection and only for the candidate select_detection already chose: depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 (camera.yaml depth is 640x480; 16UC1 is scaled by depth_scale 0.001) once per synced pair, so that copy does not multiply with deferred indexes. build_bbox_mask zero-fills a 1920x1080 mask and erodes it erode_px 2 times. sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd) = 307200, with a K_inv ray, an SE(3) into RGB, and a lookup in that full mask. Accepted points land in per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets that together reserve Hd*Wd/4 (about 1.8 MB) and are copied again, row by row, into points_depth_frame. ransac_plane_fit (up to ransac_iters 100, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) allocates a residual array and a bool mask of length n_face_points every iteration, then copies inliers into a fresh matrix for JacobiSVD. plane_inlier_mask allocates those arrays again, and the pipeline copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an N x 3 relative matrix and an N x 2 result; PCA centres another N x 2 copy. The distance image is built once per detection, not per pose. rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80: a nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m face is 561 by 350 (padded x span 2.8 m; padded y span 1.7400000000000002 m so ceil(span/0.005) is 349 and the +1 makes 350). close_mask clones the mask, runs a 5x5 elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (close_radius_px 2), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-size mask. extract_boundary_mask builds another edge image. compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. The prototype cache does not reuse that distance image. These passes are smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where the sent and deferred indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. detector.yaml and full_pipeline.launch.py set backend tensorrt at input 640 with max_detections 10 and no NMS. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() into a 1920x1080x3 array (about 6.2 MB), preprocess resizes to 640x640 and builds a float32 CHW ascontiguousarray (about 4.9 MB), and TensorRTBackend.infer copies into pinned host memory, memcpy HtoD, then copies labels, boxes, and scores back. That host traffic is upstream of the pair delivered to on_pair. The roster integers do not change it. yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the node constructor.
